theme: Suspend, foretell, plot, miracle and casting from outside the hand
reuse: Suspend() + 'exile this with three time counters on it' on resolution: rousing_refrain.go, shivan_meteor.go; 'whenever you remove a time counter from this card while it's exiled': dinosaurs_on_a_spaceship.go, triggers_common.go; Foretell(); Plot(); Miracle(); Aminatou's granted miracle at mana cost reduced by {4}: effects/granted_miracle.go (a new constructor beside MiracleForInstantAndSorceryCardsInYourHand — append, never edit); 'spells you cast from anywhere other than your hand cost less' (Savvy Trader, Sage of the Beyond): game/cost_modifier.go, vega_the_watcher.go — one helper for both; lifelink counter: keyword_counters.go.
